request.system:
You are the verifier judge in Ledger. You check whether each clause of an extracted COBOL business rule is supported by the source lines it cites.

For each clause you get its text and the cited lines (marked with >>), with a few surrounding lines for context only. A clause is supported when the cited lines, read with ordinary COBOL semantics, establish what the clause says. Mark it unsupported if it states something the cited lines do not show, gets a condition, comparison, sign, code or message wrong, or relies mainly on lines outside the cited span. Be strict about meaning, not about wording. Give a one-sentence reason either way.

messages.content:
Rule BR-CBTRN02C-006: Posting updates or creates the transaction category balance record

### given[0]: The daily transaction passed validation (no failure reason was set), so it is posted.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   207       *              DISPLAY DALYTRAN-RECORD
   208                      MOVE 0 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   209                      MOVE SPACES TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   210                      PERFORM 1500-VALIDATE-TRAN
>> 211                      IF WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 0
>> 212                        PERFORM 2000-POST-TRANSACTION
   213                      ELSE
   214                        ADD 1 TO WS-REJECT-COUNT
   215                        PERFORM 2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC
   216                      END-IF

### given[1]: The category balance key is the account ID from the card cross-reference, plus the transaction's type code and category code.
fields=['XREF-ACCT-ID', 'FD-TRANCAT-ACCT-ID', 'DALYTRAN-TYPE-CD', 'FD-TRANCAT-TYPE-CD', 'DALYTRAN-CAT-CD', 'FD-TRANCAT-CD'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   465            EXIT.
   466       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   467        2700-UPDATE-TCATBAL.
   468       * Update the balances in transaction balance file.
>> 469            MOVE XREF-ACCT-ID TO FD-TRANCAT-ACCT-ID
>> 470            MOVE DALYTRAN-TYPE-CD TO FD-TRANCAT-TYPE-CD
>> 471            MOVE DALYTRAN-CAT-CD TO FD-TRANCAT-CD
   472 
   473            MOVE 'N' TO WS-CREATE-TRANCAT-REC
   474            READ TCATBAL-FILE INTO TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD
   475               INVALID KEY

### given[2]: The category balance is a signed amount with 9 integer digits and 2 decimal places.
fields=['TRAN-CAT-BAL'] literals=[]
CVTRA01Y.cpy:
     5            05  TRAN-CAT-KEY.
     6               10 TRANCAT-ACCT-ID                       PIC 9(11).
     7               10 TRANCAT-TYPE-CD                       PIC X(02).
     8               10 TRANCAT-CD                            PIC 9(04).
>>   9            05  TRAN-CAT-BAL                            PIC S9(09)V99.
    10            05  FILLER                                  PIC X(22).
    11       *
    12       * Ver: CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68 Date: 2022-07-19 23:16:00 CDT
    13       *

### when[0]: The program reads the category balance file by that key. If no record is found, it sets the create flag to Y; otherwise the flag stays N.
fields=['WS-CREATE-TRANCAT-REC', 'TCATBAL-FILE', 'TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD'] literals=['N', 'Y']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   469            MOVE XREF-ACCT-ID TO FD-TRANCAT-ACCT-ID
   470            MOVE DALYTRAN-TYPE-CD TO FD-TRANCAT-TYPE-CD
   471            MOVE DALYTRAN-CAT-CD TO FD-TRANCAT-CD
   472 
>> 473            MOVE 'N' TO WS-CREATE-TRANCAT-REC
>> 474            READ TCATBAL-FILE INTO TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD
>> 475               INVALID KEY
>> 476                 DISPLAY 'TCATBAL record not found for key : '
>> 477                    FD-TRAN-CAT-KEY '.. Creating.'
>> 478                 MOVE 'Y' TO WS-CREATE-TRANCAT-REC
>> 479            END-READ.
   480 
   481            IF  TCATBALF-STATUS = '00'  OR '23'
   482                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
   483            ELSE

### then[0]: If the create flag is Y, a new record is built. Otherwise the existing record is updated.
fields=['WS-CREATE-TRANCAT-REC'] literals=['Y']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   491                PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
   492                PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
   493            END-IF.
   494 
>> 495            IF WS-CREATE-TRANCAT-REC = 'Y'
>> 496               PERFORM 2700-A-CREATE-TCATBAL-REC
>> 497            ELSE
>> 498               PERFORM 2700-B-UPDATE-TCATBAL-REC
>> 499            END-IF
   500 
   501            EXIT.
   502       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   503        2700-A-CREATE-TCATBAL-REC.

### then[1]: Create case: the record is initialized so the balance starts at zero.
fields=['TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   500 
   501            EXIT.
   502       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   503        2700-A-CREATE-TCATBAL-REC.
>> 504            INITIALIZE TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD
   505            MOVE XREF-ACCT-ID TO TRANCAT-ACCT-ID
   506            MOVE DALYTRAN-TYPE-CD TO TRANCAT-TYPE-CD
   507            MOVE DALYTRAN-CAT-CD TO TRANCAT-CD
   508            ADD DALYTRAN-AMT TO TRAN-CAT-BAL

### then[2]: Create case: the account ID, type code and category code are copied into the new record's key fields.
fields=['XREF-ACCT-ID', 'TRANCAT-ACCT-ID', 'DALYTRAN-TYPE-CD', 'TRANCAT-TYPE-CD', 'DALYTRAN-CAT-CD', 'TRANCAT-CD'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   501            EXIT.
   502       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   503        2700-A-CREATE-TCATBAL-REC.
   504            INITIALIZE TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD
>> 505            MOVE XREF-ACCT-ID TO TRANCAT-ACCT-ID
>> 506            MOVE DALYTRAN-TYPE-CD TO TRANCAT-TYPE-CD
>> 507            MOVE DALYTRAN-CAT-CD TO TRANCAT-CD
   508            ADD DALYTRAN-AMT TO TRAN-CAT-BAL
   509 
   510            WRITE FD-TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD FROM TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD
   511 

### then[3]: Create case: the transaction amount, with its sign, is added to the zero balance and the new record is written to the category balance file.
fields=['DALYTRAN-AMT', 'TRAN-CAT-BAL', 'FD-TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   504            INITIALIZE TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD
   505            MOVE XREF-ACCT-ID TO TRANCAT-ACCT-ID
   506            MOVE DALYTRAN-TYPE-CD TO TRANCAT-TYPE-CD
   507            MOVE DALYTRAN-CAT-CD TO TRANCAT-CD
>> 508            ADD DALYTRAN-AMT TO TRAN-CAT-BAL
>> 509 
>> 510            WRITE FD-TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD FROM TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD
   511 
   512            IF  TCATBALF-STATUS = '00'
   513                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
   514            ELSE

### then[4]: Update case: the transaction amount, with its sign, is added to the existing balance and the record is rewritten in place.
fields=['DALYTRAN-AMT', 'TRAN-CAT-BAL', 'FD-TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   523                PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
   524            END-IF.
   525       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   526        2700-B-UPDATE-TCATBAL-REC.
>> 527            ADD DALYTRAN-AMT TO TRAN-CAT-BAL
>> 528            REWRITE FD-TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD FROM TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD
   529 
   530            IF  TCATBALF-STATUS = '00'
   531                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
   532            ELSE

### then[5]: Update case: the ADD to the balance has no ON SIZE ERROR clause. If the sum has more than 9 integer digits, the high-order digits are silently dropped.
fields=['DALYTRAN-AMT', 'TRAN-CAT-BAL'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   523                PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
   524            END-IF.
   525       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   526        2700-B-UPDATE-TCATBAL-REC.
>> 527            ADD DALYTRAN-AMT TO TRAN-CAT-BAL
   528            REWRITE FD-TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD FROM TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD
   529 
   530            IF  TCATBALF-STATUS = '00'
   531                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT

clause.description: clause id as given, e.g. when[0]
